select from integration_projection_lane_work w where w.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and w.status in('READY','BLOCKED','RETRY_WAITING','RECOVERY_WAITING_INDEX') and (w.next_attempt_at is null or w.next_attempt_at<=#{dueAt}) and exists(select 1 from integration_projection_lanes l where l.tenant_id=w.tenant_id and l.lane_id=w.lane_id and l.status in('ACTIVE','THROTTLED','RECOVERING')) and not exists(select 1 from integration_projection_lane_work p where p.tenant_id=w.tenant_id and p.lane_id=w.lane_id and p.generation=w.generation and p.lane_sequence<w.lane_sequence and p.status not in('ACKNOWLEDGED','SUPERSEDED','CANCELLED')) and (w.depends_on_work_id is null or exists(select 1 from integration_projection_lane_work d where d.tenant_id=w.tenant_id and d.work_id=w.depends_on_work_id and d.status='ACKNOWLEDGED')) order by w.lane_id,w.generation,w.lane_sequence for update of w skip locked limit #{limit}

select from integration_projection_lane_work where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and status in('CLAIMED','IN_PROGRESS') and claim_until is not null and claim_until<=#{dueAt} order by claim_until,lane_id,generation,lane_sequence for update skip locked limit #{limit}
